title: Control Flow
description: Learn how to direct the execution path of your programs.

sections.title: What is Control Flow?
sections.learning_objective: Understand the concept of control flow.
sections.markdown: Control flow is the order in which individual statements, instructions, or function calls are executed or evaluated. By default, scripts execute from top to bottom, but we can change this using control structures.
key_points: Top to bottom default
Can branch or loop

sections.title: If, Elif, and Else
sections.markdown: We use if, elif, else to execute code only when certain conditions are met.
key_points: Condition evaluation
Exclusive branching

sections.title: Truthiness and Falsiness
sections.learning_objective: Understand how Python evaluates boolean contexts.
sections.markdown: Every object in Python has a boolean value. Some are considered falsiness (like 0, empty lists, None) and others truthiness.
key_points: Empty is usually false
Everything else is true

sections.title: For Loops
sections.markdown: A for loop is used for iterating over a sequence (that is either a list, a tuple, a dictionary, a set, or a string).
key_points: For Loops is a core concept to understand
Practice applying For in real code

sections.title: While Loops
sections.learning_objective: Loop while a condition is true.
sections.markdown: A while loop executes a set of statements as long as a condition is true.
key_points: While Loops is a core concept to understand
Practice applying While in real code

sections.title: Range Function
sections.markdown: The range function returns a sequence of numbers, starting from 0 by default, and increments by 1.
key_points: Range Function is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Range in real code

sections.title: Break and Continue
sections.markdown: Use break to exit a loop entirely. Use continue to skip the rest of the current iteration.
key_points: Break and Continue is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Break in real code

sections.title: Nested Control Flow
sections.markdown: You can place if statements inside loops, or loops inside other loops.
key_points: Nested Control Flow is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Nested in real code

sections.title: Match Awareness
sections.markdown: Python 3.10 introduced the match statement for structural pattern matching. Having match awareness is good for newer codebases.
key_points: Match Awareness is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Match in real code

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.markdown: Off-by-one errors in range, forgetting colons.
key_points: Common Mistakes is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Common in real code

sections.title: Interview Points
sections.markdown: Understanding loop complexities and early exits is crucial.
key_points: Interview Points is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Interview in real code
